steps.text: 5:57 P.M. \ Rainy
County Hillock, Unoccupied house in the vicinity of District Ten

steps.name: Severely Infected
steps.text: Hnngh...

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Finally awake, huh?

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Considering the damage your lungs have taken, just breathing is going to hurt like a bitch. You'd better save your air.

steps.name: Severely Infected
steps.text: *cough*, *cough*...

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Your abdomen was pretty much torn open... you're in worse shape than I thought. What kept you alive?

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Aha... not that I'm a doctor, but I know a thing or two about the anatomy of this race or that.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: My friend thought you were a Vouivre. You can't blame him for that. He's young. He never saw your ancestors tromping across the world.

steps.name: Severely Infected
steps.text: Hnnnng—!

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Simmer down. That wouldn't be good for you.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: I've seen your Arts, and I've taken some precautions. I'm afraid it won't be easy for you to set this house on fire.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Now look at that face there. Feeling a little relieved now that you know you can't fight me?

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: That might be more natural than your instinct to defend yourself—Might be the truer emotion, one from a deeper place in your heart.

steps.name: Severely Infected
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Sounds like you're mighty friendly with that word.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: You were forced to become someone you don't want to be. I can see that in your pain.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Who's using you? The moneyed ones who just have to stick their hands everywhere? Maybe the shadows in the high tower? Or some thirsty nationalists ready to bring their country back?

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: No, none of those. You're a gang with a puppet for a leader. There's no way you could've put this together in such a short time under Londinium's watchful eyes.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: You... you're a lesser kind of shadow, shoved out onto the stage.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Now does that mean your puppetmaster's of your same blood?

steps.name: Severely Infected
steps.text: Stop...

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Stop what? Too scared to even let me talk about him? Or is it her?

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Sure enough. It's not just you. The whole of Victoria... no, the whole world trembles in fear of that one.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: She must be about your age, but she turned the tables on the ones who'd use her, and so quickly too.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: It looks like change is coming sooner than I thought... We'll need to be ready.

steps.name: Severely Infected
steps.text: You... Latera...no...

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: No need to go guessing at my motives.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: I didn't care who you were when I decided to save you. Now I actually know who you are, but it hasn't changed my mind one bit.

steps.name: Severely Infected
steps.text: You... are...

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: You're better off not knowing who I am.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: As soon as you're strong enough to move, you'd best skedaddle. And don't ever tell anyone who saved you either.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: I'm not gonna let you die here. That's all you need to know.

steps.name: Severely Infected
steps.text: Okay... Thank...

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: You can thank me later. All I can do right now is remove the infected tissue and stop the bleeding.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: You got run through with the most infectious kind of Active Originium. A heaping helping of Originium granules shot into your circulatory system through those wounds.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: I gave you an inhibitor shot, but I'm afraid that won't be enough to stop crystals from forming in your organs and even on your skin there.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Soon enough, you'll pass out again with a fever. That's a good thing. Then you won't have to deal with the nasty inside-out pain that comes with the acute attack.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: You may cough up blood. I'll try to keep your head up so you don't drown in your own blood vomit.

steps.name: Severely Infected
steps.text: Ugh.... Mm-hmm...

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: And that's just the start of the suffering. You probably can't go back to your old life. Oripathy's writing a whole new course for you.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Your followers will abandon you. Some will hate you, look down on you. It won't be easy for you to lead again, and it'll be hard to get your kin to accept you as you are now.

steps.name: Severely Infected
steps.text: Hah...

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Oh? There's that face again. That's not despair. No, that's relief, at becoming an Oripathy patient?

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Well, I don't blame you. No matter how intense the artillery barrage, it's never enough to pin down a young red dragon.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: You're looking to dodge destiny, but fighting something like that's gonna come with a hefty price tag.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: I got one thing wrong there—

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: You may be less belligerent than your kin, but you're just as tenacious, and no less courageous.

steps.name: Severely Infected
steps.text: Ughh...!

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Relax. Get some sleep. I'll be here.

steps.name: Severely Infected
steps.text: It's... too...

steps.name: Severely Infected
steps.text: ...dangerous...

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: It's dangerous here? That's what you manage to squeeze out before you go dark?

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: It's definitely a little too quiet.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: I'm gonna say you're more than just a pawn to them. Looks like a change of plans.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: This is a risk, but Rhodes Island needs your intel... I'm sure Kal'tsit will understand.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Report. We haven't found her.

steps.name: 'The Bandit'
steps.text: You idiot!

steps.name: 'The Bandit'
steps.text: What good are you morons when you can't even keep track of one girl?!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: S-Sorry!

steps.name: 'The Immolator'
steps.text: You're sure she was struck?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Yes... One of my sentinels saw it himself. There was an execution this morning when the bombardment happened, The Leader might've...

steps.name: 'The Bandit'
steps.text: She's our bloody Leader! You understand, don't you?!

steps.name: 'The Bandit'
steps.text: You remember what you swore when you joined? Now you run with your tail between your legs the moment the enemy shows?!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: It—It all happened so fast! We didn't have time to respond...

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Besides, The Leader said she wanted some time alone, and ordered to keep everyone away...

steps.name: 'The Bandit'
steps.text: So what if I tell you to drop dead, you gobshite!

steps.name: 'The Bandit'
steps.text: And you tell me you're not bloody useless!

steps.name: 'The Immolator'
steps.text: Stop it. Beating him to a pulp won't do us any good.

steps.name: 'The Immolator'
steps.text: We just need to know if she's dead or alive, and where she is.

steps.name: 'The Toxicologist'
steps.text: Let... me... do it...

steps.name: 'The Immolator'
steps.text: Alright. Just don't go overboard.

steps.name: 'The Toxicologist'
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: P-Please forgive me... *sobs*... Please...

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: What's... going on... Ugh! Bleuch—

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Hah... hahahaha!

steps.name: 'The Toxicologist'
steps.text: Did you see... her...?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: She fell! She fell! Hahahahaha! She fell! Got blown up! Dead!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: ...dead...

steps.name: 'The Immolator'
steps.text: —That's what you call not overboard?

steps.name: 'The Toxicologist'
steps.text: I used... too much... Need to... remember this...

steps.name: 'The Bandit'
steps.text: Well, that's bloody disgusting. Remind me to steer clear of this sick bastard when he tests his drugs out.

steps.name: 'The Immolator'
steps.text: At least we know he wasn't lying.

steps.name: 'The Immolator'
steps.text: The blast knocked her out right here, and she was heavily injured. It was most likely fatal.

steps.name: 'The Bandit'
steps.text: But she couldn't have gone far with that wound. So where is she? It's not like she got blasted clean through the ground!

steps.name: 'The Immolator'
steps.text: I don't mind blowing up the whole street again.

steps.name: 'The Bandit'
steps.text: Next time you blow anything up, let people KNOW first!

steps.name: 'The Accountant'
steps.text: Who said we're blowing up a street?

steps.name: 'The Immolator'
steps.text: We need to find her, even if we have to burn down the whole city to do it. One street won't stop us.

steps.name: 'The Accountant'
steps.text: It's clowns like you, stupid as the Victorian Army, that make holding this city rapidly more trouble than it's worth.

steps.name: 'The Immolator'
steps.text: So what do you think we should do?

steps.name: 'The Immolator'
steps.text: Who takes the fall when The Leader finds out we lost her, huh?

steps.name: 'The Elocutionist'
steps.text: The Leader's anger is not the only thing we have to fear.

steps.name: 'The Elocutionist'
steps.text: I invite you to think about it. In the eyes of our many warriors and compatriots, she stands for Dublinn.

steps.name: 'The Elocutionist'
steps.text: If she breaks free of our control, it won't matter whether our enemies or our ill-meaning 'friends' get their hands on her. It isn't a happy ending.

steps.name: 'The Bandit'
steps.text: Come to think of it, she... she knows all our bloody plans!

steps.name: 'The Immolator'
steps.text: Say, those two ladies... do they know about this?

steps.name: 'The Accountant'
steps.text: They left as soon as the meeting was over. I don't think they would've caught word just yet.

steps.name: 'The Bandit'
steps.text: Mandragora's not fond of the girl. She's not going to care.

steps.name: 'The Immolator'
steps.text: Harmonie... I'm not even sure if she's on our side.

steps.name: 'The Elocutionist'
steps.text: Watch your words. We all stand by our Leader.

steps.name: 'The Bandit'
steps.text: Say what you will, I don't care what you do with Harmonie, but Mandragora's a good girl. Don't you dare drag her down.

steps.name: 'The Elocutionist'
steps.text: Why would we, my friend? She's an inseparable part of our team. Like us, she longs to demonstrate her talents and loyalty to the Leader.

steps.name: 'The Accountant'
steps.text: I've no idea what Harmonie said to Mandragora, or why it has her hanging onto every word. She's too happy to be doing it, too, almost like she expects something.

steps.name: 'The Immolator'
steps.text: What's so important about a transmitter that it's worth delaying our victory?

steps.name: 'The Accountant'
steps.text: The Leader still hasn't shown any hint of approval toward our plans.

steps.name: 'The Elocutionist'
steps.text: As long as we can prove to her that we've done no wrong, we still have a chance to persuade her yet.

steps.name: 'The Bandit'
steps.text: So you mean, we still have to look for her?

steps.name: 'The Elocutionist'
steps.text: Even if we must search the entire city.

steps.name: 'The Bandit'
steps.text: Alright. Enough chit-chat, then. Let's move!

steps.name: 'The Accountant'
steps.text: Wait, wake 'The Convict' up.

steps.name: 'The Bandit'
steps.text: Huh? Us five aren't enough to drag her back?

steps.name: 'The Accountant'
steps.text: Don't forget our agreement. We all will take credit for our achievements.

steps.name: 'The Bandit'
steps.text: Get a load of you... You'd sell your own mother.

steps.name: 'The Bandit'
steps.text: If the idea's to keep the outside from catching wind of this, then what are we doing with these troops?

steps.name: 'The Elocutionist'
steps.text: Naturally, we'll bring them with us. After all, the more hands, the better, until we find our quarry.

steps.name: 'The Bandit'
steps.text: And once we do...?

steps.name: 'The Elocutionist'
steps.text: I'm sure we all know what comes next.

steps.name: 'The Elocutionist'
steps.text: No one can escape Dublinn—

steps.name: 'The Elocutionist'
steps.text: And no one may ever glimpse its secrets.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: We need to get rid of these bandages—

steps.name: Young Volunteer
steps.text: But I washed them already...

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: That's not going to help. The whole box has been contaminated by the Originium on the ground. We can't be sure the dust's been completely washed off.

steps.name: Young Volunteer
steps.text: Jane, look, I know you're speaking sense, but we don't have enough supplies.

steps.name: Young Volunteer
steps.text: Look over there. They're carrying even more people in. Look at how seriously wounded they are...

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Are those...

steps.name: Young Volunteer
steps.text: Do you know them?

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: I... yes, I... knew them.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: But I don't think they'd want to see me here.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Could you look after them? I'll head for the clinic and see if I can find some supplies.

steps.name: Young Volunteer
steps.text: Jane, look! Someone's here!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Out of the way!

steps.name: Young Volunteer
steps.text: Sir, are you here to help us?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Out of the way means out of the way.

steps.name: Sorrowful Woman
steps.text: Wait, are you... Ronan?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Go block-by-block, and make sure you're thorough! There's a lot of alleys around here, and she could be hiding anywhere! Got it?

steps.name: Sorrowful Woman
steps.text: What are you doing, Ronan? It's us! Your neighbors! You put on new clothes and suddenly you don't know us?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: I have... an important mission. Piss off, or don't say I didn't warn you!

steps.name: Sorrowful Woman
steps.text: Craig's hurt. Please, help him. He's helped you out so much...

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: What are you talking about?!

steps.name: Sorrowful Woman
steps.text: *Whimpers*... I...

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: (The wounds on her back are serious...)

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: (And her kid, Craig... he's had a bad wound to his head too.)

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: (I need to stop their bleeding, but I know they don't look kindly on me...)

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: You've searched this whole place?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Are you positive no one here matches her description?

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: (Are they looking for somebody?)

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Ugh. No... no. All these people shoving in here, it's a mess. What do we say to the higher-ups if more of them sneak in once we turn and leave?

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: (Are they... looking for the woman Outcast saved?)

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: (Does that mean she's in danger...?)

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: (I need to go.)

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Oi, you lot. Get up, and leave at once!

steps.name: Young Volunteer
steps.text: Sir, we have far too many wounded here. None of them can move...

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: I give no shit you can't move. Get up and go!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: I want all these Oripathics out of this district! Keep an eye out in case they pop. Even the Originium shards outside aren't as dangerous as this lot!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Let's take a fine example. This boy with the bloody face—

steps.name: Craig
steps.text: *Whimpers*... M—Ma...

steps.name: Sorrowful Woman
steps.text: Craig, Craig! No, please don't take him! I beg you!

steps.name: Young Volunteer
steps.text: You! You're not just abandoning them, you're going to kill them?!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: What's your bloody problem?! We're Tarans, all of us! What's wrong with a sacrifice for Tara's great cause?!

steps.name: Angry Youth
steps.text: Ronan, that's what you said last time, and that's when we lost Saoirse!

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: (Saoirse...?!)

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: (It's him... He's the one who betrayed Saoirse...)

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: (And then they took her and... they...)

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: (He traded Saoirse's life for that uniform!)

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: She deserved it! She betrayed—our—trust!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: That's what you get for failing to understand our great Leader's struggle! And if you don't cooperate, you're next!

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Enough.

steps.name: Young Volunteer
steps.text: Jane? I... I thought you'd left?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: And who do you think you are? Wait, I've seen you before... You're not Taran, are you?

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Please, stop.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: You talk like it sounds so light. Who are you to decide who should sacrifice for anything?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: What's that you're holding... A banner?!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: You... You're a Victorian soldier!

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Am I...?

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: No, not anymore.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: But. If you insist on trampling the lives of the innocent, then I am your enemy.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Innocent...? Do you know what they've done? You call them innocent?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: This child, and everyone here... None of them's got clean hands.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Then... what about you?

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: You traded your own people for your position, and now you turn around to oppress them... Who will judge you?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: And who are you standing up all cocksure for? Come on, get her out of here! And round up all the Infected mingling with the Victorian deserter! It's time we clean them up!

steps.name: Sorrowful Woman
steps.text: Please, help us! Help...

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: That's far enough.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: What are you trying here? Bugger off already!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Look at you carrying that tatty banner wherever you go. You don't have what it takes to be a real soldier, do you?

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Whether that's so, or whether it's not, I will not let you continue doing evil here.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Oh, can you not even cop on? What do they have to do with you? You're going to let them fiddle you like this? Thick as a brick up there, you are!

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: True, I can't speak Taran.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: I can't cross my heart and claim I've experienced the life you all have.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: I don't have Oripathy, either.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: For the past two years, every day, I've walked the same streets as you.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: I've heard your tears. More than that, I've seen your smiles.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: I know deep down that we are all the same people, living our lives.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: As long as we're human, we will make mistakes. Those who do—should be stopped, and judged. They should be tormented by their own hearts—

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: But. It's not for some ungrateful brute to decide their fates.

steps.name: Sorrowful Woman
steps.text: You... You're going to protect us? You don't hate us?

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: *Exhale*... I'd be lying... if I said 'not at all.'

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: I'll stop pretending... there's no bitterness between us. What Craig did was wrong, too, and I've no intention of shielding any guilt.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: But a friend has taught me—the evil I see before me has to be stopped.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: This has nothing to do with which side I'm on. I'm doing what's right.

steps.name: Sorrowful Woman
steps.text: Th—Thank you...

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Calm down, Craig. You don't need to tug so hard.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: It doesn't matter if I was ever a good soldier. I've been ready to fight from the moment I deserted.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: But your wounds...

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: (Rip—)

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: The banner's the cleanest thing I have on me, and there's a better use for it right now.
Jane gently wraps the torn piece of the banner around the wounded child's forehead.

steps.name: Craig
steps.text: *Sobs*... I—I'm sorry... M... Miss...

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Don't worry for now, Craig. You get some rest.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: As for you, soldier, it's time you leave—

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: And before you do, you'll need to pay for what you did to Saoirse.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: What, and you'll make me, all by yourself?

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: If I have to.

steps.name: Angry Youth
steps.text: ...We're with you too.
One by one, the wounded men with less serious injuries step out of their hiding spots and stand behind Jane, the girl with her banner held up high.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: What... What are you all doing?!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Are you going to resist Dublinn?! O'Brien, you should be helping me get her! Don't forget how Damian died!

steps.name: Angry Youth
steps.text: No, Ronan. I haven't forgotten about Damian, but on the other hand... I haven't forgotten about Saoirse either.

steps.name: Angry Youth
steps.text: We've done a lot of bad... I'm not blind. Now that it's come to this, I can tell who's really been trying to help us all along.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: She's not even Taran!

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Do you see the looks in their eyes?

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: We stand together. For now, at the very least.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: You... absolute idiots! You'll all die here for your foolishness!

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Watch your injuries. Don't push yourselves.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Leave these villains to me.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: I will win this battle...

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: No—together, we will win this!
